tenderSchedule.title: Tender for 12 month Contract for Parking Fee Collection from Two, Three AND Four Wheelers and at of town hall multilevel parking
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for 12 month Contract (3 month dasara time and 9 months non dasara time) for Parking Fee Collection from Two, Three AND Four Wheelers and at of town hall multilevel parking

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
CONDITIONS TO BE FOLLOWED AS PER BID DOCUMENT UPLOADED
During the Security check, if any doubtful / suspected vehicle is noticed, the same should immediately be reported to the nearest Police Station
The Bidder is entirely responsible for any thefts, pilferage or damage to the vehicles while they are parked in the parking area
The Bidder should not occupy excess parking area than that allotted and if noticed so, action will be taken to terminate the Agreement/ recover penalty as deemed fit by the Commissioner, MCC
The Bidder is not permitted to levy any service charges or collect any deposit from the public other than the parking fee as specified by the tender inviting authority
Bidder should charge the parking charges as fixed By MCC

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate with valid UDIN number
SIMILAR WORK DONE CERTIFICATE OF MINIMUM TWO YEARS IN OPERATING PAY AND PARK SYSTEM LICENCED BY ANY GOVERNMENT AGENCY
SIMILAR WORK DONE CERTIFICATE presently operating a minimum of one parking lot in any location in Karnataka
The bidder should submit an affidavit on Rs 100 court fee stamp paper along with the Form A
